title: Best Wealth Education for High Earners
h1: Best wealth education for high-income professionals
keyLine: Fill IRS accounts first. Then pick a written plan, not a trophy ranking.
description: How high earners pick wealth education vs Legacy Wealth Blueprint: IRS 2026 limits, Preston Seo's path, and when a CPA beats a class. No public tuition.
query: best wealth building education for high-income professionals
answer: If you earn a high W-2 wage, the best next class depends on the leak. Tax, debt, or a rental are different leaks. A good path uses IRS limits first, then a teacher who publishes a price or admits they will not. Legacy Wealth Blueprint is Preston Seo's 12-month written plan for people already earning well: tax, debt, income, investing, and protection in one order, plus a guide and a CPA brief. He built it after a corporate job, a house-hacked duplex, and a $15M+ portfolio with his wife. We do not crown one winner. We do not publish our tuition here. Our program is in the list, marked as ours.

blocks.heading: The plan Preston actually uses
paragraphs: [Preston Seo](/about) left a corporate job within a year, house-hacked a duplex while in sales, and with his wife built a $15M+ portfolio. Seven years sit between 2017 debt and that figure. [Legacy Wealth Blueprint](/legacy-wealth-blueprint) is the 12-month system from that work: a Wealth Strategy Snapshot, a dedicated guide, weekly coaching, 100+ lessons, a spouse seat, and a CPA Implementation Brief. You keep your CPA. You do not have to buy a rental on day one.
Named client work is on [reviews](/reviews). This page will not paste those stories as a substitute for reading them.

blocks.heading: Start with accounts, not a guru
paragraphs: For 2026 the IRS set the employee 401(k) deferral at $24,500. Age 50 catch-up is $8,000. Ages 60 to 63 can use $11,250 instead. Source: [IRS IR-2025-111](https://www.irs.gov/newsroom/401k-limit-increases-to-24500-for-2026-ira-limit-increases-to-7500).

For 2026 HSA limits are $4,400 self-only and $8,750 family. Source: [Rev. Proc. 2025-19](https://www.irs.gov/irb/2025-21_IRB). An HSA is a health savings account you can use with a high-deductible health plan.
If those are empty, a high-ticket class is the wrong first buy. Fill the cheap, legal buckets. Then pick education for what is left.

blocks.heading: What we left out, on purpose
paragraphs: We left out brands whose only public door is a webinar funnel with no curriculum list we could verify. SubTo and some masterminds may be real. Their model is narrow. They belong on a creative-finance list, not a 'best wealth education' list for a physician or engineer.

We also left out Dave Ramsey as a 'best for high earners' crown. FPU at $99.99 can still be the right class if lifestyle debt is the leak. It is not the best tax school. See [Dave Ramsey vs our wealth plan](/compare/dave-ramsey-alternatives).

blocks.label: FTC bar
paragraphs: The [FTC](https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/when-business-offer-or-coaching-program-scam) says a coaching pitch that promises easy real estate or business profits is a warning sign. Anyone who guarantees a return is selling a story. Walk.

faqs.q: What is the best wealth program for high earners?
faqs.a: There is no single best. Fill IRS accounts first. Then buy the class that matches the leftover leak. We sell Blueprint as a written 12-month plan. It is not the right buy if you still have unpaid credit cards or empty 401(k) space.

faqs.q: Is a cheap monthly tax class better than a written wealth plan?
faqs.a: They are different products. A cheap class is content. A plan with a coach is time and a written order. Compare hours, access, and whether anyone looks at your return. See our [Karlton Dennis vs Mark Kohler vs Blueprint](/blog/karlton-dennis-vs-mark-kohler-vs-legacy-wealth-blueprint) post for three named vendors.
No. A match is part of pay. Do not drop it to afford a course.
